Women in Car Pursued, Attacked on Ranchi Highway

A video circulating online shows a Scorpio vehicle pursuing and attacking a car carrying women on the Ranchi-Tata highway on July 7. The Scorpio occupants allegedly threw stones, breaking the car's window. The incident occurred in the Dasham Falls area. Police have since provided clarification regarding the event. Former Chief Minister Marandi criticized the government over the incident.
